title: VP, Quality & Regulatory
text:
**The Krusteaz Company**
is looking for a
**Vice President of Quality & Regulatory**
! The VP, Quality & Regulatory is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the organization's enterprise-wide quality, regulatory affairs, and compliance programs. As the organization's primary authority on quality systems, regulatory strategy, and compliance integrity, they ensure that all operations meet or exceed applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and internal policies.
 
 
**Essential Functions:**
Other duties, responsibilities, and activities may change or be assigned at any time.
 
 

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve an enterprise-wide Quality Management System aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
* Establish quality standards, policies, and procedures that drive consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across all business units and functions.
* Champion a culture of quality throughout the organization through visible leadership, targeted training programs, and clear performance accountability frameworks.
* Oversee internal audit programs, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, root cause analysis, and management review activities to identify, address and prevent recurrence of quality issues while driving measurable, systematic improvement.
* Serve as the organization's primary liaison with regulatory agencies (e.g., FDA, State Agencies and industry-specific authorities), accreditation organizations, and industry trade associations, cultivating credible relationships and maintaining organizational awareness of evolving regulatory and industry expectations.
* Monitor, interpret, and proactively communicate evolving regulatory requirements and their organizational impact to senior leadership and operational teams. Ensure all regulatory registrations, licenses, certifications, and required filings, ensuring timely renewal and full compliance.
* Design and oversee a comprehensive, risk-based enterprise compliance program encompassing regulatory, legal, and ethical compliance obligations across all operational areas.
* Ensure organizational adherence to applicable federal and state laws, regulations, standards, and internal policies through effective program design, monitoring, and enforcement mechanisms.
* Lead company’s Sustainability initiatives to ensure effectiveness and compliance for certifications, reporting, Extended Producer Responsibility, and Social Accountability programs. Provide guidance to Senior Leadership on risks, trends, or emergent issues and support implementation of improvements.
* Align the quality, regulatory, and compliance strategy with overall organizational objectives, ensuring that QRC is positioned as a strategic enabler rather than a compliance overhead.

**Position Requirements:**
*To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals qualified with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* Strong executive presence and business acumen and demonstrated ability to operate both strategically and tactically across the enterprise.
* Ability to translate complex regulatory and compliance landscapes into clear, actionable organizational strategies.
* Ability to recruit, build, lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance team capable of supporting current and future organizational needs.
* Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-accountability team culture where expertise is valued, professional growth is supported, and performance standards are clear.
* Cultivate strong cross-functional partnerships across the business to embed quality and compliance into day-to-day operations.
* Serve as a contributing member of the senior leadership team, actively participating in strategic planning, enterprise risk management, and organizational governance.
* Advise Senior Leadership on regulatory and compliance risks, emerging issues, and strategic opportunities presented by the evolving regulatory landscape.
* Represent the organization externally at industry forums, regulatory proceedings, accreditation reviews, and with key external stakeholders.

**Supervisory Responsibilities:**
Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems
 
 
**Education and/or Experience:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Food Science or related degree; or equivalent experience/training.
* Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 15 years of progressive, substantive experience in quality management, regulatory affairs, and/or compliance within a regulated industry.
* Minimum 7 years of demonstrated senior leadership experience managing cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams in a complex organizational environment.
* Proven track record of building, scaling, and continuously improving quality and compliance programs in organizations of meaningful size and complexity.
* Documented experience managing regulatory agency relationships, leading inspection readiness programs, and representing the organization during regulatory inspections and agency meetings.
* Experience operating in a multi-site, multi-jurisdictional, or global organizational environment with oversight of geographically distributed teams.
* Direct experience leading quality and regulatory due diligence activities in the context of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, or significant partnership transactions.

**Get to know us:**
Learn more about our Corporate Office and Culture.
 
 
**Hybrid Work Model:**
At The Krusteaz Company, we have in-office "core days" of Tuesdays and Wednesdays where all corporate employees are expected to be onsite. Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays are flexible remote days to allow for work/life balance. You may be asked to come in outside of a core day from time to time, based on business needs. We have found aligning our scheduled in-office days provides an opportunity for employees to build connections and collaborate together.
 
 
**Benefits:**
We are proud to offer generous benefits including comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance (starting at $105/month for employee-only coverage on the PPO Plan or starting at $45/month for employee-only coverage on the HDHP), 401(K) matching, 4 weeks of paid vacation, 10 paid holidays, 1 paid personal holiday, company-provided life insurance and disability insurance, flexible spending account, healthcare savings account, voluntary accident insurance, voluntary critical illness insurance, and tuition reimbursement. Learn more about our Benefits.
 
 
**Salary Information:**
An employee in this position based out of Washington State can expect a salary range between $218,900 and $349,534. We typically pay out between $240,000 and $300,000. The actual salary offered will be carefully considered based on a wide range of factors, including internal equity, experience, education, certification, training, and location. All positions are eligible for additional incentives based on business performance.
 
 
**Physical Demands & Work Environment:**
While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, sit, talk, hear, and use hands and fingers to operate a computer and telephone along with reaching. Specific vision abilities include close vision requirements due to computer work. Moderate noise, ability to work in a confined area, and ability to sit at a computer for an extended period of time are also included.
 
 
The policy of Continental Mills, Inc. dba The Krusteaz Company, Inc. is to hire, train, and promote all persons in all job groups in accordance with law, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital or military status, national origin, gender identity, the presence of any sensory, mental or physical disability, genetic information, or any other status or characteristic protected by local, state, or federal law.
 
 
*The Krusteaz Company is not sponsoring new applicant employment authorization at this time, and please, no third-party recruiters.*
